sites.label: Forestry Camp
sites.blurb: Fells timber on a forest node. Makes logs, sawdust and wood chips.

sites.label: Farm
sites.blurb: Grows grain on farmland. Makes grain and bran.

sites.label: Clay Pit
sites.blurb: Digs clay on a clay node by the water. Makes clay and sand.

sites.label: Dairy Ranch
sites.blurb: Grazes cattle on pasture. Makes milk and whey.

sites.label: Orchard
sites.blurb: Grows fruit on an orchard node.

sites.label: Quarry
sites.blurb: Cuts stone from a pit at the foot of a mountain. Makes stone and gravel.

sites.label: Cotton Farm
sites.blurb: Grows cotton on farmland. Makes cotton and bran.

sites.label: Coal Mine
sites.blurb: Mines coal on a coal seam in the hills. Makes coal and stone.

sites.label: Iron Mine
sites.blurb: Mines iron ore on an ore deposit in the hills. Makes iron ore and stone.

sites.label: Coffee Plantation
sites.blurb: Terraced coffee on an island highland. Makes coffee and bran. Islands only, so it has to come by ship.

sites.label: Mango Grove
sites.blurb: Mango trees in the island sun. Makes mangoes and fruit. Islands only, so they have to come by ship.

sites.label: Oil Well
sites.blurb: Pumps crude oil from a field. Makes oil and sand. Found on a few islands, so it has to come by ship.

sites.label: Sand Pit
sites.blurb: Digs sand on open ground. Makes sand and gravel.

sites.label: Sawmill
sites.blurb: Logs in, lumber out. Sawdust is the by-product.

sites.label: Flour Mill
sites.blurb: Grain in, flour out. Bran is the by-product.

sites.label: Bakery
sites.blurb: Flour in, bread out. Towns love bread.

sites.label: Dairy
sites.blurb: Milk in, cheese out. Whey is the by-product.

sites.label: Jam Factory
sites.blurb: Fruit and sugar in, jam out.

sites.label: Feed Mill
sites.blurb: Bran and whey in, animal feed out. Puts two by-products to work.

sites.label: Garden Supply
sites.blurb: Sawdust and bran in, mulch out. A second life for two by-products.

sites.label: Recycling Yard
sites.blurb: Takes any by-product, a few units a minute, for a few cents each. Nothing can jam a chain when it has a Recycling Yard to go to.

sites.label: Water Pump
sites.blurb: Pumps clean water by the shore. Breweries, canneries and ice cream plants need it, and trucks carry it in.

sites.label: Chicken Farm
sites.blurb: Hens on pasture. Makes eggs and feathers.

sites.label: Vegetable Farm
sites.blurb: Market-garden rows on farmland. Makes vegetables.

sites.label: Potato Farm
sites.blurb: Deep furrows on farmland. Makes potatoes.

sites.label: Barley Farm
sites.blurb: Golden barley on farmland. Makes barley and straw.

sites.label: Hop Farm
sites.blurb: Tall hop vines on poles. Makes hops, the beer flavour.

sites.label: Sugar Beet Farm
sites.blurb: Beet fields on farmland. Makes sugar beet and pulp.

sites.label: Sunflower Farm
sites.blurb: Bright sunflower fields. Makes seeds for cooking oil, and husks.

sites.label: Pig Farm
sites.blurb: Pigs on pasture. Makes pork.

sites.label: Sheep Farm
sites.blurb: Sheep on pasture. Makes wool.

sites.label: Apiary
sites.blurb: Hives among the orchard blossom. Makes honey and wax.

sites.label: Vineyard
sites.blurb: Rows of vines on the orchard slopes. Makes grapes.

sites.label: Salt Pan
sites.blurb: Seawater dried in shallow pans by the shore. Makes salt.

sites.label: Spice Plantation
sites.blurb: Island spices in the heat. Makes spices. Islands only, so they have to come by ship.

sites.label: Cocoa Plantation
sites.blurb: Cocoa pods under shade trees on an island highland. Makes cocoa. Islands only, so it has to come by ship.

sites.label: Fishing Harbor
sites.blurb: A quay on the coast. Its fishing boats go out and come back on their own, and fill the harbor with fish. Trucks carry the fish to where it is needed.

sites.label: Smokehouse
sites.blurb: Fish, salt and firewood in, smoked fish out.

sites.label: Fish Cannery
sites.blurb: Fish, salt and water in, canned fish out.

sites.label: Fish Meal Plant
sites.blurb: Fish scraps and spent grain in, animal feed out. Two leftovers put to work.

sites.label: Wood Yard
sites.blurb: Logs in, firewood out. Wood chips are the by-product.

sites.label: Creamery
sites.blurb: Milk in, butter out. Whey is the by-product.

sites.label: Juice Press
sites.blurb: Fruit in, juice out. Pulp is the by-product.

sites.label: Sugar Refinery
sites.blurb: Sugar beet in, sugar out. Pulp is the by-product.

sites.label: Oil Press
sites.blurb: Sunflower seeds in, cooking oil out. Husks are the by-product.

sites.label: Pastry Kitchen
sites.blurb: Flour, eggs and sugar in, pastries out.

sites.label: Noodle Maker
sites.blurb: Flour and eggs in, pasta out.

sites.label: Pizzeria
sites.blurb: Flour, cheese and vegetables in, pizza out.

sites.label: Cannery
sites.blurb: Vegetables and salt in, canned food out.

sites.label: Butcher
sites.blurb: Pork in, meat out.

sites.label: Brewery
sites.blurb: Barley, hops and water in, beer out. Spent grain is the by-product.

sites.label: Soft Drink Plant
sites.blurb: Sugar and water in, soft drinks out.

sites.label: Wool Mill
sites.blurb: Wool in, yarn out.

sites.label: Compost Yard
sites.blurb: Wood chips, pulp and straw in, mulch out. Three leftovers put to work.

sites.label: Silage Plant
sites.blurb: Straw, husks and spent grain in, animal feed out. Three leftovers put to work.

sites.label: Winery
sites.blurb: Grapes and water in, wine out. Pulp is the by-product.

sites.label: Distillery
sites.blurb: Barley and water in, spirits out. Spent grain is the by-product.

sites.label: Ice Cream Plant
sites.blurb: Milk and sugar in, ice cream out.

sites.label: Crisp Fryer
sites.blurb: Potatoes, cooking oil and salt in, crisps out.

sites.label: Sausage Maker
sites.blurb: Pork, salt and spices in, sausage out.

sites.label: Chocolate Maker
sites.blurb: Cocoa, sugar and milk in, chocolate out.

sites.label: Candle Maker
sites.blurb: Wax and cotton in, candles out.

sites.label: Pillow Maker
sites.blurb: Feathers and cotton in, pillows out.

sites.label: Granite Cutter
sites.blurb: Stone in, granite out. Gravel is the by-product.

sites.label: Fuel Refinery
sites.blurb: Crude oil in, fuel out.

sites.label: Pellet Mill
sites.blurb: Presses sawdust into heating pellets.

sites.label: Paper Mill
sites.blurb: Logs in, paper out.

sites.label: Spinning Mill
sites.blurb: Cotton in, yarn out.

sites.label: Weavery
sites.blurb: Yarn in, cloth out.

sites.label: Garment Factory
sites.blurb: Cloth in, clothes out. Big money.

sites.label: Furniture Workshop
sites.blurb: Lumber and cloth in, furniture out.

sites.label: Printery
sites.blurb: Paper in, books out.

sites.label: Brickworks
sites.blurb: Clay in, bricks out.

sites.label: Stonecutter
sites.blurb: Stone in, cut blocks out. Gravel is the by-product.

sites.label: Cement Works
sites.blurb: Gravel and coal in, cement out.

sites.label: Concrete Plant
sites.blurb: Cement, sand and gravel in, concrete out. Puts gravel to work.

sites.label: Glassworks
sites.blurb: Sand and coal in, glass out.

sites.label: Smelter
sites.blurb: Ore and coal in, iron ingots out. Slag is the by-product.

sites.label: Toolworks
sites.blurb: Ingots and lumber in, tools out.

sites.label: Steelworks
sites.blurb: Ingots and coal in, steel out.

sites.label: Slag Crusher
sites.blurb: Turns slag into gravel and sand.

sites.label: Machine Works
sites.blurb: Steel and tools in, machinery out. The top of the chain.

sites.label: Distribution Warehouse
sites.blurb: Holds finished goods like food and furniture and sells them on to other towns. Raw and building goods go to a Supply Yard.
sites.real: Like a real distribution centre: finished goods wait on the shelf until a town buys them.

sites.label: Mechanic Shop
sites.blurb: Trucks that wear out go here and come back repaired. A better shop is quicker, and a better mechanic repairs past new for a while.
sites.real: Like a real truck garage: a mechanic fixes the worn ones and sends them back out.

sites.label: Rail Yard
sites.blurb: A rail freight terminal at the edge of a town. Goods are loaded onto trains here, and unloaded and sent into town when trains arrive.
sites.real: Like a real rail yard: where freight is loaded onto trains and unloaded again.

sites.label: Port
sites.blurb: A seaport. Goods are loaded onto ships here, and unloaded and sent into town when ships arrive.
sites.real: Like a real seaport: cranes load containers onto ships and unload them again.

sites.label: Market
sites.blurb: Where the town buys finished goods that people use every day.

sites.label: Supply Yard
sites.blurb: Where the town buys raw and building goods: logs, lumber, grain, ore, bricks, steel and leftovers.

sites.label: District
sites.blurb: A town district: a building on a lot beside the streets, supplied by your trucks.

sites.label: Rail Station
sites.blurb: Where trains serve a town. Goods unloaded here are sold on to its Market and Supply Yard.

sites.label: Airport
sites.blurb: An air cargo terminal on a 5x3 field: a long runway runs across the back and the road comes in at the front, where an arrow shows the turn. Goods are loaded onto cargo planes here, and unloaded and sent into town when planes land. Upgrades build out the terminal, from airfield to regional to international.
sites.real: Like a real air cargo terminal: freight is loaded onto planes and unloaded again.

vehicles.label: Fishing Boat
vehicles.blurb: Goes out from its Fishing Harbor and comes back on its own. Each boat makes the harbor catch more fish.

vehicles.label: Box Truck
vehicles.blurb: Small, cheap, good for short hauls.

vehicles.label: Big Box Truck
vehicles.blurb: Twice the load of a box truck.

vehicles.label: Big Rig
vehicles.blurb: Large trailer, faster on the highway.

vehicles.label: Truck Fleet
vehicles.blurb: A convoy of rigs that moves as one. The top of the road ladder.

vehicles.label: Freight Train
vehicles.blurb: Huge capacity on its own track. Rails cross roads at level crossings.

vehicles.label: Heavy Haul Train
vehicles.blurb: A long unit train for the busiest lines.

vehicles.label: Cargo Plane
vehicles.blurb: Fast, crosses any terrain. Flies between airports.

vehicles.label: River Barge
vehicles.blurb: Flat and shallow: sails rivers and lakes, and the coast.

vehicles.label: Cargo Boat
vehicles.blurb: A small coastal freighter. Needs a wide channel.

vehicles.label: Freighter
vehicles.blurb: A proper cargo ship with a crane and a hold.

vehicles.label: Container Ship
vehicles.blurb: Boxes stacked high. Carries more than any other vehicle.

vehicles.label: Cargo Jet
vehicles.blurb: A wide-body freighter for the longest hauls.

districts.label: Farmers Market
districts.blurb: Stalls of fresh produce. Buys honey, juice and pasta that the Market ignores.

districts.label: Restaurant Row
districts.blurb: Kitchens that burn through bread, cheese and jam.

districts.label: Heating Depot
districts.blurb: Warms the town in winter. Wants pellets, coal and oil from the islands.

districts.label: Coffee House
districts.blurb: The corner cafe. Pays well for island coffee, with bread, jam and milk to go with it.

districts.label: Hardware Store
districts.blurb: Tools, timber and bricks for every home.

districts.label: Warehouse District
districts.blurb: Deep storage. Docks hold more, so prices hold up under heavy deliveries.

districts.label: Builders' Yard
districts.blurb: Brick, block and glass for a growing skyline.

districts.label: Furniture Gallery
districts.blurb: Showrooms for timber and cloth.

districts.label: Fashion Quarter
districts.blurb: Boutiques that pay well for cloth and clothes.

districts.label: Library and Bookshops
districts.blurb: Paper and books, read in quiet rooms.

districts.label: Freight Terminal
districts.blurb: Raw goods and bulk freight find a better buyer.

districts.label: Community Centre
districts.blurb: A hall for classes, clubs and markets. Wants books, furniture, bread and milk.

districts.label: Amphitheatre
districts.blurb: Open-air stage and tiered seating. Timber, cloth and paper for the shows.

districts.label: Football Stadium
districts.blurb: Game day fills the town. Wants bread, cheese, milk, clothes and coffee for the crowd.

districts.label: Baseball Park
districts.blurb: Summer evenings and a full house. Wants bread, fruit, paper, clothes and coffee.

districts.label: Soccer Stadium
districts.blurb: The beautiful game, under floodlights. Wants bread, fruit, milk, clothes and coffee for the supporters.

districts.label: Hockey Arena
districts.blurb: An indoor arena on ice. Wants milk, cheese, clothes, steel and coffee.

districts.label: Beach Resort
districts.blurb: Pool, palms and a long list of guests. Pays well for mangoes and coffee. Income grows with the variety the town offers.

districts.label: University
districts.blurb: Educated townsfolk. Everything the town buys makes it grow faster.

districts.label: Foundry Row
districts.blurb: Casting yards that buy iron and steel in bulk. The Forge only.

districts.label: Hotels and Promenade
districts.blurb: Visitors pay by how much variety the town offers.

districts.label: Grand Food Hall
districts.blurb: The pride of the Breadbasket. Every food good sells at a premium.

districts.label: Heavy Industry Exchange
districts.blurb: Where the Forge sets the price of steel and machinery.

districts.label: International Terminal
districts.blurb: Cargo from everywhere passes through. Every good pays a little more.

districts.label: Grand Plaza
districts.blurb: Theatre, galleries and a skyline. Fine goods pay a premium.
